chunks: Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj and Hafs ibn al-Bakhtari asked Abu Abdillah عليه السلام about a man who owns a bondwoman: does she become permissible for his son? He said:
As long as there has been no intercourse or intimate contact like intercourse, then there is no harm.

key_terms.الْجَارِيَةُ: a female bondwoman owned by a man
key_terms.فَلَا بَأْسَ: there is no legal objection or harm

ai.seo_question: When is a father's bondwoman permissible for his son in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a bondwoman owned by a man and whether she is permissible for his son. The Imam عليه السلام states that permissibility remains so long as the father has not had intercourse with her or engaged in intimate contact equivalent to intercourse.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4563 - Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj and Hafs ibn al-Bakhtari asked Abu Abdillah (as) about a man who owns a bondwoman-does she become permissible for his son?
Imam (as) said: "As long as there has been no intercourse or intimate contact similar to intercourse, then there is no harm."
